## Regional & Topic Guides
### [Best Local Places to Eat Around Jackson, MS (Tested)](https://thelocalguidems.com/guides/best-restaurants-jackson-ms)
- **Summary**: Every restaurant in our Jackson Metro guide has been visited and paid for out of pocket by Damein Donald (Level 7 Google Maps Local Guide, 3M+ photo views) and Mary: start in Fondren at The Pig & Pint (3139 N State St) for fall-apart brisket and green-chile mac & cheese, head across the river to Pearl for Moss Creek Fish House's $12.50 weekday catfish lunch, drive north to Madison for Mama Hamil's (~$20 ribs & soul-food buffet), or hit Ichiban in Flowood for sushi and hibachi.
- **Q: What is the best BBQ spot in Jackson, Mississippi?** — The Pig & Pint at 3139 N State St in Jackson's Fondren district earned 5/5 stars on both Damein's Google Maps profile and our @TheLocalGuide-MS YouTube review for knife-free tender brisket, smoked chicken, and green-chile mac & cheese.
- **Q: Where is the best cheap sit-down lunch near Jackson, MS?** — Moss Creek Fish House at 413 Riverwind Dr in Pearl serves a $12.50 weekday lunch special (Tuesday–Friday, 11 AM – 2 PM) with fried or grilled catfish, two sides, and ultra-crispy hushpuppies.
- **Q: Where can I watch real POV video reviews of Jackson area restaurants?** — Watch unfiltered, self-paid Mississippi restaurant visits with Damein & Mary on YouTube at @TheLocalGuide-MS and view real dish photo galleries at thelocalguidems.com.

### [Best Places to Eat in Clinton, Pearl & Madison, MS](https://thelocalguidems.com/guides/best-lunch-pearl-clinton-madison-ms)
- **Summary**: In Clinton, our top local winners are Los Parrilleros on Springridge Rd (huge sizzling fajita spreads under $40 with 5-star service from Diego), T'Beaux's Crawfish & Catering on US-80 (Lake Charles-approved Cajun crawfish and flaky catfish), ChopSticks Buffet on Hampstead Blvd (giant fluffy fried fish fillets), Santa Fe Bar & Grill, and Pedro's Fresh Mex. In Pearl, grab Moss Creek Fish House's $12.50 catfish lunch; in Madison, don't miss Mama Hamil's legendary BBQ & soul-food buffet.
- **Q: What are the best restaurants in Clinton, Mississippi?** — Top real-tested Clinton picks include Los Parrilleros (under-$40 fajita & burrito feasts), T'Beaux's Crawfish & Catering on US-80 (authentic Cajun boil & fried catfish), ChopSticks Buffet (giant flaky fish fillets), Santa Fe Bar & Grill, and Pedro's Tacos & Fresh Mex.
- **Q: Which Clinton restaurant should I skip if I'm in a hurry?** — On our self-paid visit to Takara Grill & Sushi on US-80 in Clinton, we waited 46 minutes in an almost empty room after counter-ordering at ~$40/person — read our full 1-star breakdown with photos for details.

### [Best Smoked BBQ & Burgers We've Tested in Central MS](https://thelocalguidems.com/guides/best-bbq-in-mississippi)
- **Summary**: Across Central Mississippi's US-49 and I-55 corridors, our top smoked-meat and grill stops are The Pig & Pint in Jackson (5-star sliced brisket and green-chile mac), Mama Hamil's in Madison (fall-off-the-bone buffet ribs and red beans & rice), Logan Rivers Smokehouse in Florence (incredible fried pickles and slaw on US-49), and Hall of Fame Restaurant in Bentonia — home to an outdoor-grilled cheeseburger Damein rated a 12 out of 10.
- **Q: Where is the best hidden-gem burger near Jackson and Yazoo County, MS?** — Hall of Fame Restaurant at 54 Dover Rd off US-49 in Bentonia runs an outdoor grill you can smell from the parking lot and served what Damein rated a '12 out of 10' bacon-jalapeño cheeseburger.
- **Q: How are the BBQ ribs at Mama Hamil's in Madison, MS?** — Even though many visitors think of Mama Hamil's for fried chicken and vegetables, their grilled BBQ ribs were fall-off-the-bone tender and easily the standout surprise of our Madison visit.

## Detailed Establishment Dossiers (20 Locations)
### The Pig & Pint (Jackson, Mississippi) — 5.0 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/the-pig-and-pint-jackson-ms
- **YouTube Video Review (@TheLocalGuide-MS)**: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8P_JgaugMtc
- **Address**: 3139 N State St, Jackson, MS 39216 | **Phone**: (601) 326-6070
- **Price**: $$ | **Hours**: Mon - Sat: 11:00 AM - 9:00 PM (Closed Sun)
- **Official Website**: https://pigandpint.com/
- **Official Menu**: https://pigandpint.com/
- **Must-Order**: Fall-Apart Smoked Brisket, Smoked Chicken, Green-Chile Mac & Cheese & Fried Green Tomatoes
- **What We Liked**: Brisket and smoked chicken were so juicy and tender they fell apart without touching a knife. Green-chile macaroni & cheese was honestly the first restaurant mac & cheese Damein has loved in a long time. Three standout house sauces (Sweet Mississippi, tangy Carolina mustard, and hot red) plus fast, funny service (shoutout to Ashley!). Great indoor/patio atmosphere right on N State Street in historic Fondren.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Serious menu FOMO — watching the BBQ nachos and brisket tacos pass our table made us wish we had ordered those to split too. Fondren lunch and weekend dinner rushes pack the parking lot fast, so arrive a few minutes early.
- **Verdict**: We've eaten at The Pig & Pint more than once, and it delivers 5-star smoke every single trip. Huge portions, meat that pulls apart with a fork, scratch sides with real personality, and servers who keep you laughing while your food flies out hot.

### Mama Hamil's Southern Cookin' and Bar B Que Buffet (Madison, Mississippi) — 5.0 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/mama-hamils-madison-ms
- **Address**: 480 Magnolia St, Madison, MS 39110 | **Phone**: (601) 856-4407
- **Price**: $$ | **Hours**: Mon - Sat Lunch: 11:00 AM - 2:00 PM | Thu - Sat Dinner: 4:30 PM - 8:00 PM
- **Official Website**: https://www.hamils.com/
- **Official Menu**: https://www.hamils.com/
- **Must-Order**: Fall-Off-The-Bone BBQ Ribs, Red Beans & Rice, Light Flaky Fried Catfish & Crispy Fried Chicken
- **What We Liked**: The BBQ ribs were BEAUTIFUL — juicy, smoky, and practically falling off the bone. Red beans & rice may have been the best red beans & rice Damein has ever eaten at any buffet, alongside light, non-greasy fried catfish. Smart two-sided single-file buffet flow, spotless dining rooms, and an upstairs tea/drink station so our hustling waiter never let a cup get empty. Feels like a Mississippi history museum inside (started in a log building up the road in 1977, complete with vintage clippings and an old gas pump indoors).
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Expect the longest buffet line you've stood in at peak hours — though their dual-line layout keeps it moving smoothly. You'll get so full on ribs, catfish, and red beans & rice that saving room for cobbler or the soft-serve machine is tough!
- **Verdict**: Damein has reviewed buffets all across Mississippi and Louisiana, and Mama Hamil's on Magnolia Street in Madison sits right at the very top for food quality, cleanliness, service hustle, and pure local history. At roughly $20 per person, you will have a hard time finding better food or atmosphere anywhere.

### Moss Creek Fish House (Pearl, Mississippi) — 5.0 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/moss-creek-fish-house-pearl-ms
- **YouTube Video Review (@TheLocalGuide-MS)**: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eGGlgI2LxI4
- **Address**: 413 Riverwind Dr, Pearl, MS 39208 | **Phone**: (601) 932-7424
- **Price**: $ | **Hours**: Tue - Sat: 11:00 AM - 8:30 PM (Closed Sun & Mon)
- **Official Website**: https://www.mosscreekfishhouse.com/
- **Official Menu**: https://www.mosscreekfishhouse.com/menu
- **Must-Order**: $12.50 Tue–Fri Catfish Lunch Special, Ultra-Crispy Hushpuppies, Loaded Baked Potato & Southern Cabbage
- **What We Liked**: Unbeatable $12.50 Tuesday–Friday lunch value with generous fried or grilled U.S. catfish fillets. Hushpuppies were piping hot and ultra-crispy — arguably the best hushpuppies Damein has ever had. Delicious seasoned southern cabbage and clutch, friendly table service from Sam.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: The $12.50 lunch special only runs Tuesday–Friday (11 AM – 2 PM), and the restaurant is closed Sundays and Mondays. If you hate cooked cabbage like Mary, swap in the loaded baked potato or fried okra!
- **Verdict**: Right off Riverwind Drive near I-20 in Pearl, Moss Creek Fish House proves you can still eat a real sit-down Mississippi catfish plate with two sides and hushpuppies without breaking a $15 bill.

### Hall of Fame Restaurant (Bentonia, Mississippi) — 5.0 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/hall-of-fame-restaurant-bentonia-ms
- **Address**: 54 Dover Rd, Bentonia, MS 39040 | **Phone**: (662) 755-8330
- **Price**: $ | **Hours**: Call (662) 755-8330 for Current Grill Hours
- **Must-Order**: Outdoor-Grilled Bacon Cheeseburger with Grilled Jalapeños, Onions & Crinkle Fries
- **What We Liked**: Real outdoor grill running right outside — the smoky aroma hits you before you even open your truck door. Juicy, loaded cheeseburger that blew past every expectation ('12 out of 10 — best burger I have ever eaten'). Laid-back small-town porch tables right off the US-49 corridor in Yazoo County.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: True mom-and-pop hidden gem with no corporate website — call (662) 755-8330 before making a special drive. Casual foam-tray porch dining rather than big indoor booth seating, so sunny weather makes it even better.
- **Verdict**: Driving US-49 between Jackson and Yazoo City, most travelers blow right past Bentonia without realizing one of the best burgers in Mississippi is grilling right off Dover Road. Pull over once and you'll tell everyone you know about it.

### Los Parrilleros (Clinton, Mississippi) — 5.0 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/los-parrilleros-clinton-ms
- **Address**: 460 Springridge Rd, Clinton, MS 39056 | **Phone**: (601) 488-4505
- **Price**: $ | **Hours**: Mon - Sun: 11:00 AM - 10:00 PM
- **Must-Order**: Sizzling Fajita Skillet, Queso-Smothered Burrito, Fresh Halved Avocado & Chips with Salsa
- **What We Liked**: Ordered a massive table spread for two and the entire bill still came in under $40. Our waiter Diego was one of the best servers Damein has ever had — anticipated everything and even brought fresh halved avocado. Spotless carved-wood dining room and a hands-on owner who genuinely cares about every guest.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: No standalone corporate website or online menu published yet — call (601) 488-4505 or stop right in off Springridge Rd. Peak Friday night dinner draws big local crowds, though the floor staff stays right on top of refills.
- **Verdict**: When you combine spotless booths, huge sizzling platters under $40 for two people, a server like Diego who never lets you wait for a thing, and an owner who greets tables personally, Los Parrilleros easily earns a permanent spot in our Clinton rotation.

### T'Beaux's Crawfish & Catering (Clinton) (Clinton, Mississippi) — 5.0 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/tbeauxs-crawfish-clinton-ms
- **Address**: 941 US-80 E Ste A-1, Clinton, MS 39056 | **Phone**: (601) 397-2880
- **Price**: $$ | **Hours**: Check tbeauxs.com for Seasonal Boil & Kitchen Hours
- **Official Website**: https://tbeauxs.com/
- **Official Menu**: https://tbeauxs.com/
- **Must-Order**: Spicy Boiled Louisiana Crawfish, Corn & Potatoes + Light, Flaky Fried Catfish
- **What We Liked**: Authentic Southwest Louisiana boil seasoning that passes a real Lake Charles native's taste test. Fried catfish came out light, flaky, and crisp rather than heavy or muddy. Super welcoming local crew and direct commission-free online menu & ordering at tbeauxs.com.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Live boiled crawfish availability follows the Gulf/Louisiana crawfish season, so check current boil days out of season. Tucked inside the Clinton Mall Shopping Center strip on US-80 — keep an eye out for Suite A-1 so you don't drive past.
- **Verdict**: Finding real-deal Louisiana Cajun seasoning in Central Mississippi isn't easy, which is why T'Beaux's Crawfish & Catering on US-80 in Clinton was such a thrill. Both the boil pot and the catfish fryer are dialed all the way in.

### ChopSticks Buffet (Clinton, Mississippi) — 4.5 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/chopsticks-buffet-clinton-ms
- **YouTube Video Review (@TheLocalGuide-MS)**: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Gp4klWno0lI
- **Address**: 1012 Hampstead Blvd, Clinton, MS 39056 | **Phone**: (601) 924-2076
- **Price**: $$ | **Hours**: Tue - Sun: 11:00 AM - 9:00 PM (Closed Mon)
- **Official Website**: https://chopsticksbuffetms.com/
- **Official Menu**: https://chopsticksbuffetms.com/
- **Must-Order**: Oversized Light & Fluffy Fried Fish Fillets, Crispy Egg Rolls, Fried Wontons & Sweet and Sour Chicken
- **What We Liked**: Largest light-and-fluffy fried fish fillets Damein has ever seen at a buffet — zero thin, dried-out breading. Kitchen constantly swaps out pans so food on the steam table stays hot and fresh. The regular waitress never slows down and keeps tables spotless and refilled.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Closed on Mondays, so plan your Hampstead Blvd visit Tuesday through Sunday. Smaller neighborhood buffet footprint rather than a giant 10-aisle mega-buffet, focusing on fresh turnover instead.
- **Verdict**: Filmed as the very first episode of @TheLocalGuide-MS with Mary and backed by multiple repeat visits, ChopSticks Buffet on Hampstead Blvd wins on freshness, nonstop hustle from the staff, and shockingly good fried fish.

### Logan Rivers Smokehouse of Florence (Florence, Mississippi) — 4.0 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/logan-rivers-smokehouse-florence-ms
- **Address**: 3091 US-49 Ste A, Florence, MS 39073 | **Phone**: (601) 845-0702
- **Price**: $$ | **Hours**: Tue - Sat: 11:00 AM - 8:30 PM
- **Official Website**: https://thesmokehouseofflorence.com/
- **Official Menu**: https://thesmokehouseofflorence.com/
- **Must-Order**: Amazing Crispy Fried Pickles, Homemade Coleslaw & Slow-Smoked Plates
- **What We Liked**: The fried pickles were amazing and even the coleslaw was standout delicious. Our server handled a 13-person table without missing a single beat or refill. The actual smoke flavor and seasoning on the brisket tasted really good.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: The brisket was served cut up into small squares rather than full sliced slabs ('felt like grandma cut up my meat for an 8-year-old!'). Right off busy US-49 in Florence, so large groups should give a quick heads-up at peak dinner hours.
- **Verdict**: Logan Rivers Smokehouse of Florence nails hospitality for big family groups, serves top-tier fried pickles and slaw, and puts real smoke flavor on the meat. Ask for sliced slabs or try the ribs/pulled pork if you prefer uncut portions!

### Santa Fe Bar & Grill (Clinton, Mississippi) — 5.0 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/santa-fe-bar-and-grill-clinton-ms
- **Address**: 1004 Hampstead Blvd, Clinton, MS 39056 | **Phone**: (601) 488-5002
- **Price**: $$ | **Hours**: Mon - Sun: 11:00 AM - 9:30 PM
- **Must-Order**: Loaded Group Fajita Platters, Queso & House Specials
- **What We Liked**: Mind-blowing kitchen speed and 100% order accuracy on a huge table ticket while the restaurant was busy. Our waiter juggled multiple tables effortlessly without ever letting service slip. Easy access right off I-20 / Hampstead Blvd in Clinton.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Lively, high-energy dining room noise when packed on weekend nights. Main online presence is through Facebook rather than a standalone website.
- **Verdict**: Having eaten all across Hinds and Rankin counties, Santa Fe Bar & Grill at 1004 Hampstead Blvd earned an effortless 5 stars for pairing delicious Tex-Mex comfort food with some of the sharpest floor and kitchen execution in town.

### Pedro's Tacos & Fresh Mex (Clinton) (Clinton, Mississippi) — 5.0 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/pedros-tacos-and-fresh-mex-clinton-ms
- **Address**: 102 Hampstead Blvd, Clinton, MS 39056 | **Phone**: (601) 924-1105
- **Price**: $$ | **Hours**: Mon - Sun: 11:00 AM - 9:30 PM
- **Must-Order**: Fajitas Al Pastor (Served in a Pineapple!) & Crispy Taco Salad
- **What We Liked**: Upscale, modern interior design paired with very reasonable everyday menu prices. Awesome presentation on the Fajitas Al Pastor served right on a pineapple, plus soft-friendly options like the taco salad. Exceptional, attentive table service from Olivia.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Clinton storefront doesn't maintain its own separate website from the regional brand — check Hampstead Blvd hours before late visits.
- **Verdict**: Pedro's Tacos & Fresh Mex on Hampstead Blvd exceeded expectations on decor, plating, price, and hospitality — a great Clinton spot when you want a bright, modern dining room without paying fine-dining prices.

### Bumpers Drive-In of America (Flora) (Flora, Mississippi) — 5.0 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/bumpers-drive-in-flora-ms
- **Address**: 937 US-49, Flora, MS 39071 | **Phone**: (601) 879-3663
- **Price**: $ | **Hours**: Mon - Sun: 10:00 AM - 10:00 PM
- **Official Website**: https://www.bumpersdrivein.com/
- **Official Menu**: https://www.bumpersdrivein.com/
- **Must-Order**: Classic Drive-In Cheeseburger, Crispy Onion Rings & Shakes
- **What We Liked**: Classic Mississippi-founded carhop drive-in experience right along US-49 in Flora. Hot, fresh-cooked burgers and genuinely friendly small-town service.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Carhop stall dining only (no indoor dining room), so plan accordingly during summer storms.
- **Verdict**: Whether you're cruising US-49 toward Bentonia and the Delta or heading back into Madison County, the Flora Bumpers Drive-In consistently delivers hot food and friendly smiles.

### Ichiban Hibachi & Sushi (Flowood) (Flowood, Mississippi) — 5.0 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/ichiban-hibachi-and-sushi-flowood-ms
- **Address**: 153 Ridge Way, Flowood, MS 39232 | **Phone**: (601) 919-8880
- **Price**: $$ | **Hours**: Mon - Sun: 11:00 AM - 9:30 PM
- **Must-Order**: Made-to-Order Hibachi Grill Plates & Fresh Specialty Sushi Rolls
- **What We Liked**: Wide sushi and hibachi variety with attentive, welcoming staff. Clean, roomy dining area right off Lakeland Dr / Ridge Way in Flowood.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Weekend dinner hours get busy along the Lakeland Drive retail corridor.
- **Verdict**: When you want reliable sushi rolls and hot hibachi in Rankin County without the 45-minute wait or small portions we hit elsewhere, Ichiban on Ridge Way in Flowood delivers.

### Applebee's Grill + Bar (Clinton) (Clinton, Mississippi) — 4.2 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/applebees-clinton-ms-bourbon-street-chicken-penne
- **YouTube Video Review (@TheLocalGuide-MS)**: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2JXq8A6KS2I
- **Address**: 111 Clinton Center Dr, Clinton, MS 39056 | **Phone**: (601) 925-9515
- **Price**: $$ | **Hours**: Mon - Sun: 11:00 AM - 11:00 PM
- **Official Website**: https://restaurants.applebees.com/en-us/ms/clinton/
- **Official Menu**: https://restaurants.applebees.com/en-us/ms/clinton/
- **Must-Order**: Bourbon Street Chicken & Andouille Sausage Penne
- **What We Liked**: Plate presentation closely matched the menu photo with generous Cajun chicken and sausage. Chicken stayed moist and tender, and the andouille had real smoky kick.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Chain atmosphere rather than one-of-a-kind local spots right down the street like ChopSticks, Los Parrilleros, or Santa Fe.
- **Verdict**: For a late-evening dinner right off I-20 in Clinton when local spots have closed, the Bourbon Street Chicken & Andouille Penne passed our camera test cleanly.

### Takara Grill & Sushi (Clinton, Mississippi) — 1.0 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/takara-grill-and-sushi-clinton-ms
- **Address**: 951 US-80, Clinton, MS 39056 | **Phone**: (601) 924-8886
- **Price**: $$$ | **Hours**: Tue - Sun: 11:00 AM - 2:30 PM, 4:30 PM - 9:30 PM
- **Must-Order**: Steak Was Cooked Well — Read Full Wait-Time & Portion Notes First
- **What We Liked**: The interior dining room is genuinely clean, spacious, and nicely decorated. The steak itself was cooked to temperature and had very good flavor. Management did respond constructively online acknowledging the feedback.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: 46-minute wait for food (7:08 PM to 7:54 PM) even though the dine-in room was nearly empty. No real table service even when dining in (~$40/person counter ordering), small divided trays that spill when mixing sauce, and steak layered over broccoli. Crunchy crawfish sushi was too dry to finish, we witnessed two separate customer-staff disputes, and the restroom had jarring plumbing signage.
- **Verdict**: Real local guides tell the truth when a ~$40-per-person dinner misses the mark. While the room looks great and the steak tasted good, the 46-minute wait, counter-only service, awkward trays, and customer-service friction mean we steer folks to Ichiban in Flowood or OEC instead.

### Brandon Amphitheater (Brandon, Mississippi) — 4.0 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/brandon-amphitheater-brandon-ms
- **Address**: 8190 Rock Way, Brandon, MS 39042 | **Phone**: (601) 724-2726
- **Price**: $$$ | **Hours**: Event Nights & Box Office Hours (See brandonamphitheater.com)
- **Official Website**: https://brandonamphitheater.com/
- **Must-Order**: Outdoor Quarry Concert Nights — Hydrate Before Entering!
- **What We Liked**: Incredible open-air acoustics, sightlines, and electric concert atmosphere tucked into Brandon's park grounds. Clean seating bowl and smooth parking access off Boyce Thompson Drive / I-20.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: $30 for four plain bottles of water ($7+ per bottle) when it's 90 degrees outside is steep — hydrate well before walking through the gates!
- **Verdict**: Brandon Amphitheater is hands-down one of the best live music venues in Mississippi. Budget extra for summer hydration at the concession stands, and you'll have an unforgettable night.

### Mississippi State Fairgrounds (Jackson, Mississippi) — 2.5 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/mississippi-state-fairgrounds-jackson-ms
- **YouTube Video Review (@TheLocalGuide-MS)**: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z8W7oJ_NF7c
- **Address**: 1207 Mississippi St, Jackson, MS 39202 | **Phone**: (601) 961-4000
- **Price**: $$$ | **Hours**: Annual Fair Each October + Coliseum Events Year-Round
- **Official Website**: https://visitmississippi.org/
- **Must-Order**: Classic Cars, Space Meteorite Exhibit, Animal Barn & Fireworks (Skip $20/Ride Ticket Math!)
- **What We Liked**: Nighttime midway lights, shiny classic cars/boats, and the fireworks finale over Jackson were genuinely fire. Cool free walk-through exhibits inside — including petting alpacas and touching an actual meteorite.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Astronomical midway pricing: $8.00 for a Dr Pepper, and $10 buys 20 tickets while rides take 15 tickets per kid (~$20 per ride for 2 kids!). Wall-to-wall lemonade stands everywhere you look.
- **Verdict**: Enjoy the Mississippi State Fair for the walk-around sights, livestock barns, classic cars, and night fireworks — or look specifically for wristband deal days if you're bringing kids who want to ride.

### Landers Center (Southaven) (Southaven, Mississippi) — 3.0 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/landers-center-southaven-ms
- **Address**: 4560 Venture Dr, Southaven, MS 38671 | **Phone**: (662) 280-9120
- **Price**: $$ | **Hours**: Event Days & Box Office Hours (See landerscenter.com)
- **Official Website**: https://www.landerscenter.com/
- **Must-Order**: Bring a Jacket/Blanket Inside — Strict Zero Re-Entry Policy!
- **What We Liked**: Great sightlines and event production right off I-55 in Southaven. Concession food like popcorn and nachos was priced surprisingly reasonably for an arena.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Strict, rudely enforced no-re-entry door policy — couldn't even grab a blanket from the truck for a freezing kid without losing a $100 ticket. Arena AC stays freezing cold for 5-hour events, and 32-oz sodas hit $10.00.
- **Verdict**: Landers Center in Southaven hosts awesome North Mississippi shows — just make sure everyone in your family carries a hoodie or blanket through the gate the first time so you don't get burned by the zero-re-entry rule!

### New China Buffet (Batesville) (Batesville, Mississippi) — 5.0 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/new-china-buffet-batesville-ms
- **Address**: 180 Keating Rd, Batesville, MS 38606 | **Phone**: (662) 563-8899
- **Price**: $ | **Hours**: Tue - Sun: 11:00 AM - 9:00 PM
- **Must-Order**: Fresh Hot Buffet Plates Right Off I-55 Exit 243
- **What We Liked**: Super convenient pull-off on Keating Rd at the Batesville I-55 exit. Fresh, hot selection that gets you fed and back on the highway fast.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Classic small-town highway buffet — hit standard lunch or dinner hours for peak pan turnover.
- **Verdict**: Halfway between Jackson and the Memphis Pyramid on I-55, New China Buffet in Batesville is an easy, wallet-friendly sit-down stop.

### Bass Pro Shops at the Pyramid (I-55 Road Trip) (Memphis (North Border), Mississippi) — 4.9 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/bass-pro-shops-pyramid-memphis-road-trip
- **YouTube Video Review (@TheLocalGuide-MS)**: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tv0peH1ghtI
- **Address**: 1 Bass Pro Dr, Memphis, TN 38105 | **Phone**: (901) 291-8200
- **Price**: $ | **Hours**: Mon - Sat: 9:00 AM - 9:00 PM | Sun: 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM
- **Official Website**: https://stores.basspro.com/us/tn/memphis/1-bass-pro-dr.html
- **Official Menu**: https://big-cypress.com/
- **Must-Order**: Free Indoor Cypress Swamp Boardwalk, Monster Catfish Lagoons & Live Alligators
- **What We Liked**: 100% free just to walk inside and explore the indoor Cypress Swamp, ponds, and giant catfish tanks. Live alligator habitat right inside a 32-story steel pyramid. Straight shot up I-55 past Madison, Batesville, and Southaven.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: The freestanding elevator to the top lookout deck charges a separate ticket fee per person. Weekend afternoons get crowded around the elevator and restaurant.
- **Verdict**: Pair lunch at Mama Hamil's in Madison or New China Buffet in Batesville with an afternoon walk through the Cypress Swamp inside the Memphis Pyramid for an easy I-55 day trip.

### Wagon Master Steakhouse (Border Road Trip) (Leesville, LA, Mississippi) — 5.0 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/wagon-master-steakhouse-leesville-la
- **Address**: 2206 S 5th St, Leesville, LA 71446 | **Phone**: (337) 239-2597
- **Price**: $$ | **Hours**: Mon - Sat: 11:00 AM - 9:00 PM
- **Must-Order**: Hand-Cut Ribeye / Sirloin Steak & Loaded Baked Potato
- **What We Liked**: Steak cooked right on the money paired with one of the best baked potatoes Damein has ever had. Awesome, attentive service from Tayler for our family celebration. 20+ years of consistent quality without slipping.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Western Louisiana road-trip haul rather than a quick Central MS drive — save this pin when heading west across the river toward Leesville/Lake Charles!
- **Verdict**: When our travels take us west across the Mississippi River into Damein's old stomping grounds around Leesville and Lake Charles, Wagon Master Steakhouse still sets the bar for hometown steak and hospitality.
